title: phlox carolina subsp. angusta
intro: Phlox carolina subsp. angusta, commonly known as Carolina phlox, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the phlox family, native to the southeastern United States. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a possible treatment for wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Phlox carolina subsp. angusta may include antioxidant, antispasmodic, and vasodilatory effects, contributing to its use in traditional medicine for conditions such as fever, respiratory issues, and cardiovascular problems. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
